description: Create a short link (https://app.qrtap.kg/<slug>) when the user asks for a LINK rather than a printed code. It is the same managed object as a QR code and hits the same endpoint as qrtap_create_code — the reply's short_url is permanent, the destination is retargetable, scans are counted. Pick this one only when the user wants nothing but a link; if they need a label, a group, an external_ref or a batch, use qrtap_create_code / qrtap_create_codes_bulk, which take those fields.

url.description: Destination URL the short link should redirect to (http/https).

name: qrtap_create_short_link
